bends.reason: Tile 1/3. The solid line is parallel to the crease but drawn on flat flange material, never on the crease. It sits at original-image row ~209, while the yellow B3 bend band runs from row ~253 to ~313 (centre ~283) and the grey dashed nominal line is at ~290. At 10 px/mm that is ~7.4 mm from the band centre and ~8 mm from the nominal line, ~4.4 mm outside the band edge and just below the two flange holes. The band is 6 mm wide face-on, which puts Ri+t at about 4 mm or less, so max(2 mm, Ri+t) is exceeded along 100% of the line. The section panel agrees: the measured dot is ~8.5 mm off the apex x. Tiles 2 and 3 and the global ISO, DIMENSIONS and FRONT views all show the B3 line on the crease at this end, so this tile contradicts them and is probably a corrupted control. Judged on what it shows: does not land. The label '3 · B3 · 8806e4' is identical to the recipe CAD label at the same spot.

Tile 2/3. The solid line (row ~289.5) is on the B3 bend-band centre (band ~252-313) and matches the grey dashed nominal line. It is parallel along the whole tile (158.7 mm). It crosses a ~30 mm U-shaped relief cut into the plate (x ~654-952) where the crease is cut away. Under the convention that one fold interrupted by a relief is one line, the continuous line is correct. Even if the gap is counted as off the crease, 80.8% of the line's length here lies on the crease. Across the gap the line stays within ~2 mm of the remaining bend material. The bold label '3 · B3 · 8806e4' matches the CAD label at the same spot.

Tile 3/3. The solid line (row ~289.5) is on the B3 bend-band centre (band ~254-314), coincides with the nominal line and is parallel. It covers the whole crease in this tile, ending ~1 mm before the band ends at the rounded part edge, where only the short grey dashed nominal line continues. The label '3 · B3 · 8806e4' matches the CAD label at the same spot. The stray dark point below the line has no bearing on the verdict.
